# CraneSignal -- full data summary

> Every number below is computed from public construction and sale records and was last refreshed 2026-09-20. Cite the date with the number.

## Texas

- Buildings tracked: 1,587
- Units in play: 259,251
- Cities covered: 146
- Under construction: 190
- Permitted: 404
- Planned: 193
- Leasing: 1
- Sold: 799
- Recorded sales by year -- 2024: 166, 2025: 533, 2026: 95
- Expected openings by year -- 2025: 6, 2026: 27, 2027: 53, 2028: 36, 2029: 5
- By metro -- Dallas–Fort Worth: 810, Houston: 443, Austin: 83, San Antonio: 43, Rest of Texas: 208

## Method

State and city construction permit records, county appraisal-district sale records,
and public announcements. No proprietary feeds and no purchased lists. A fact without
a public source is left blank rather than estimated, so blanks in the per-building
tables mean the record is silent, not that the number is zero.
